gloss: to hang down; to dangle; to droop

definitions.gloss: to hang down; to dangle; to droop
definitions.explanation: For a thin or flexible object — a rope, hair, branch, sleeve, drop of liquid — to extend downward under its own weight. Intransitive.

examples.japanese: ⟦ロープ→ロープ：27860_roopu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{垂|た}れ{下|さ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{垂|た}れ{下|さ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Her long hair hangs down to her shoulders.
Under the weight of the snow, the pine branches are hanging down to the ground.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{垂|た}れる→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧ (to hang/drip) + ⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ (to descend). Intransitive, describing a state or process — usually paired with て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ for the resulting state.

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The transitive counterpart is ⟦{垂|た}らす→垂らす：05339_tarasu⟧ (to let dangle, to hang down) or the compound {垂|た}れ{下|さ}げる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{垂|た}れ{下|さ}がる: hair hangs down
- ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{垂|た}れ{下|さ}がる: branches droop
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{垂|た}れ{下|さ}がる: sweat trickles down
- ⟦{紐|ひも}→紐：02251_himo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{垂|た}れ{下|さ}がる: a string dangles

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{垂|た}れる→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧: to hang, to drip — more general; often used for liquids
- ⟦ぶら{下|さ}がる→ぶら下がる：05541_burasagaru⟧: to dangle — emphasizes hanging from a fixed point, often with swinging motion
